gpu.note: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 3.05bpw shapes (H 2560, I 640, 1.86 MB blob), _moe_a9.so moe_forward_cached, all picks VRAM-resident, back-to-back calls (graph-like, queue kept full). Linear fit over 10/19.8/38.9/74.9 unique experts per layer call: M=1 0.0746, M=2 0.1265, M=4 0.2065, M=8 0.3547 ms. per_extra_token: pair mode (M<=4, the default) reads an expert once per (token, expert) pair, so an extra token on the same expert costs ~ a new expert (+0.0046 M2, +0.0038 M4 ms); M=8 runs grouped MR=2 (+0.0023). Grouped read-once dispatch (pair_max_m 0, MR = M) cuts it to ~0.0012 for shared experts but is slower for spread routing (M8 random 0.452 vs 0.352 ms). Plain moe_forward is 0.013 ms/layer cheaper (M1 0.0616). Previous value 0.0063/expert with 0 per_layer (N106). Run b70-microbench-2026-10-07, contended (slot A busy).

zerocopy.note: Qwen shapes, kernel reads the host copy over PCIe (pinned USM and memfd THP via xe SVM measure the same, +-5%). Link-bound: 1.86 MB at ~23.3 GB/s; mixed calls (j of 10 picks host-resident) add 0.073-0.083 ms per host expert on top of its VRAM cost; cached path all-miss with max_fill 0: 0.085 ms/expert; with write-through to a VRAM slot: 0.073 ms/expert over the all-hit call (write-through is ~free). Pair mode re-streams the blob for every token on it (shared M2 +0.069, M4 +0.079 ms per extra token-expert; M8 MR=2 +0.027); grouped read-once (MR = M) makes extra tokens ~free (shared M8 0.842 ms = M1 0.828 ms). Previous 0.052 (N109) is below the 0.070 ms PCIe floor at 26.7 GB/s, so it was L2-assisted; this run rotates 1,024 experts so no call hits L2. Run b70-microbench-2026-10-07, contended (slot A busy): re-measure idle before shipping a number.

glm-5.3-flash-exl3-3.05bpw.note: GLM-5.3-Flash 3.05bpw expert shape (H 4096, I 2048, K 3, 9,474,048 B blob, top-8 of 288) on the same kernels. Stock _moe_a8/_a9 cannot run it: gate|up needs (H/16)/P % 8 == 0 and down (I/16) % P == 0 with P in {5,10,20,40}; N124 build _moe_n124.so adds power-of-two splits (GU P 4/8/16, DN P 4/16); these lanes were measured at gu 8 / dn 16, and 4/4 scans 3-6% faster. Checked against exl3xpu_C.linear per projection on real layer-3 experts: rel L2 err 0.0012 for every split. VRAM: cached b2b M=1 0.181, M=2 0.3435, M=4 0.683, M=8 1.309 ms (8/15.9/30.8/58.1 unique); weights stream at ~445 GB/s (73% of 608 peak). Zero-copy: 0.41 ms/expert (link-bound, 9.47 MB at ~23 GB/s); a B70 zero-copy lane costs about the same per expert as the 3090's (0.38). Missing for real GLM serving: the swiglu_limit 10 clamp on gate/up inside the kernel, and routed_scaling_factor 2.5 (foldable into topk_w; the sglang plugin rejects it today). Run b70-microbench-2026-10-07, contended.

overheads.note: torch 2.13+xpu on the B70: 1-element add_ submit (host) / submit+synchronize / idle synchronize / event record+query spin; landed flag = host writes seq into pinned USM, enqueues 4 B H2D + 4 B D2H, spins on the host word (no synchronize); flag_after_kernel = wall from enqueue to flag seen minus kernel device time on an idle queue. Run b70-microbench-2026-10-07.
